Our Expertise in CMS Development

<01>

Website Design and Development

The CMS web developer you hire with Mobilunity will prepare the sitemap and wireframe of your future website. Then, coders and UI/UX designers will create your website layout, which shows the structure, functions, color schemes, images, etc. Coders will use the CMS system and technologies that meet your requirements and follow current standards.

<02>

CMS Customization

Our custom CMS developer will tailor content management tools to your needs. With content indexing, pre-built templates, and built-in file managers, you’ll boost the performance of your content team. It’ll get insightful analytics, helpful approval workflows, and role-based accesses. Moreover, a CMS customization will allow you to ensure regulatory compliance.

<03>

CMS Theme Development

No matter the platform, an experienced CMS web developer will help you implement the right design for your brand. This expert will create your website theme with a unique style and advanced functionality. Visitors will feel the vibe of your products or services when navigating your website packed with features. 

<04>

Plugin or Module Development for CMS

A skilled developer CMS will make widgets, add-ons, and extensions work for your website in the best way. These components help improve web pages’ performance and pack them with niche-specific functions. With plugins and modules, you can secure your web resource, make it more responsive and feature-rich, and get necessary reports.

<05>

CMS Migration and Upgrades

Switching to advanced technologies is often a must for businesses. A CMS engineer hired by Mobilunity will help you upgrade your digital presence without hustle. They also realize quick CMS migrations, even if your website has a complex infrastructure. Our coders will develop a thorough plan, transfer all the tools, and maintain connections.

<06>

E-commerce Integration with CMS

Synchronizing your Magento, WooCommerce, or Shopify with a CMS platform is vital nowadays. This integration allows sellers to optimize workflows. They can process orders, monitor inventories, manage prices, change product descriptions,  etc., from a single dashboard. CMS web developers will unite the two platforms so you can grow conversions and improve customer experiences.

{work with}

CMS We Work With

WordPress

Over 43% of global websites are built on WordPress because this platform is reliable and highly customizable. Unlike some other solutions, this website builder grants your content ownership. Our WordPress CMS developers will allow you to leverage multiple plugins and other advantages of this system to meet your web presence needs.

Shopify

The look, content, and functionality of your Shopify eCommerce solution are vital. Though this platform offers versatile customizations, picking the right functionalities can be demanding. Hire Shopify developers to run your e-shop effectively and offer your buyers an improved customer experience. A programmer will leverage Shopify’s marketing and SEO tools to promote your brand.

Square

Do you use Square to process payments and want to integrate it with your app or website? Power your company with a Square developer. Professionals will leverage tools like Square API Explorer, Square Sandbox, GraphQL, and others. So your customers will enjoy an improved buyer experience.

Magento

This powerful platform for online shops offers exceptional performance and outstanding customization. When you hire CMS web developers to integrate your content management system with Magento, you grow your revenues. Preferred payment methods, simplified product catalogs, and advanced personalization are only a few features.

WooCommerce

You can reduce the burden of maintaining an online store with this WordPress plugin. WooCommerce allows sellers to manage inventories, track orders, handle deliveries, etc., without switching between the platforms. And a CMS programmer will help you make the transition and start using this cost-effective combo. You’ll also access multiple customization opportunities.

HubSpot

HubSpot helps grow your website’s search ranking with its advanced SEO recommendations. Also, it offers helpful stats and valuable reports about your visitors. But to leverage the platform’s features like integration with HubSpot CRM or design customization, you’ll need to hire HubSpot CMS developer. And Mobilunity’s team will help you do that.

Leverage The Expertise Of CMS Developers For Custom Solutions!

Seeking skilled CMS developers to enhance your website or content management system? Look no further. Our team of expert developers specializes in CMS development and customization.

How to Hire a CMS Developer with Mobilunity

{01}

Determine Your Needs

You may not always know the exact team composition at this stage. So, we propose you draft the top-level project scope and consider timeframes. Add budget limitations, if any. This will let you estimate how many CMS website developers you need and for which period. If you’re not ready with precise numbers, we’ll help you get an optimized solution.

{02}

Get in Touch With Us Using the Form Below

Now, fill in the web form with the answers. Will you need an expert for a few hours a week, or should you hire remote CMS developers full-time? Do you expect your project to finish in three months, or will it take over half a year? Let us know these details here.

{03}

Receive Estimate and Offer From Us

Once we receive your query, we’ll call you to discuss the details and recommendations. We’ll need several days to check the availability and average salary of each CMS engineer. We’ll explore what makes similar vacancies attractive and prepare an offer with estimated project costs.

{04}

Interviewing Candidates

When you approve the plan and the budgets, our recruiters start searching for the best-matching CMS programmers. We run HR interviews but also can arrange tech interviews. So, if you need engagement from lead CMS developers, let us know. You get a short list of candidates at the end of this stage.

{05}

Start Your Cooperation

Once you define future team members, we send them job offers and start hiring. We sign a cooperation agreement and onboard your CMS developers. From now on, we will handle all the operating and legal issues while you set tasks for your new team.

FAQs on Hiring CMS Developers

What do CMS website developers do?

A Content Management System (CMS) programmer creates websites using specialized platforms (WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, etc.). CMS developers are responsible for the back-end functionalities that allow you to publish, change, and manage your content. Also, these experts work on the front-end part, ensuring your web pages look stylish and brand-aligned.

Can you assist in conducting CMS Developer technical interviews?

Absolutely, assistance for CMS Developer technical interviews is part of the specialized services we provide for an extra fee. We organize technical interviews with leading CMS experts, perfect for teams requiring expertise in content management systems. You will receive a detailed report and feedback from the interviewer, enhancing your understanding of the candidate’s proficiency in CMS development.

What skills should a CMS programmer possess?

When you hire remote CMS developers, ensure they have strong knowledge of top CMS platforms like Magento, Shopify, Joomla, Drupal, etc. A professional should know web development, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Backend skills are also critical as they allow coders to implement additional features and customizations. So, ensure PHP, Python, Ruby, Django, Laravel, and other technologies are on the CV.

How can I check a CMS developer’s expertise?

Explore their past projects and make sure they have worked with your chosen platform. Try asking for references or reading testimonials. However, to find your best CMS developer, we recommend running a tech interview and giving a test task to the applicant.

What’s the cost to hire CMS developer?

Payrolls depend on the project scope, complexity, coder’s background, and location. For instance, in the USA, the average annual salary of a CMS developer is $103,220. In Ukraine, a WordPress expert can earn up to $22,800. The hourly rate of US and EU-based CMS coders can range between $20 and $100.

Is it okay to hire CMS Developers for remote work?

Yes, like other developers, CMS programmers can work remotely. However, you should use effective collaboration tools like Slack, Trello, and Zoom. Also, it’s critical to set deadlines and arrange regular check-ins. Like every remote team member, a CMS developer needs clear communication and motivation to cooperate.
